newsitem.title: GERMANY: LME People - Deutsche confirm trader departures.
newsitem.headline: LME People - Deutsche confirm trader departures.

text.p: Base metals traders Mark Jevons, Graham Smith and Nigel Kirby left Deutsche Bank Sharps Pixley Metals in London earlier this week, Deutsche Bank in Frankfurt said on Friday, confirming market talk.

The move was a personnel decision in line with the restructuring and strengthening of management at Deutsche Bank's banking business Morgan Grenfell in London, said Fritz Plass, global head of metals and commodities.
"We appointed a new head of global base metals at Morgan Grenfell, David Surtees, on Oct 8," he said.
Jevons, Smith and Kirby asked to resign under amicable circumstances, Plass said.

Surtees started as an LME floor trader, spent time in Switzerland trading and hedging physical metals and then went on to work for Drexel Burnham Lambert, Paine Webber and most recently, Union Bank of Switzerland.
